agent_explanation: With actuated=true, EW green held long while NS waited ~70s (recall demand). When EW finally gap-out at step 92 it entered EW yellow, but the actuated recall logic forced the transition to all-red after only 2s (steps 92-93) instead of the required yellow_seconds=4, turning E/W red at step 94. Disabling actuation removes the early truncation, confirming actuated control interrupts/cuts the yellow interval to serve the long-waiting direction.
